column1: # Kernewek (kw) catalogue. Columns, separated by a TAB: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id; it takes precedence over the English text
#            @plural              `source` is "one|other"; translations follow the plural rule
#            anything else        a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# NOTE: This is a starter subset from the translation workbook, not a complete catalogue.
# Cornish wording is unreviewed; please have a fluent speaker review it before public release.
